# CA Sunil Kumar, FCA — governance and risk management for NGOs and the social sector

> Chartered Accountant with 30+ years in NGO and development-sector finance, audit and governance. Author of books on NGO governance, strategic finance and personal effectiveness, and creator of the Institutional Governance Maturity Assessment self-assessment toolkits, in public use since June 2026. This site sells books and self-assessment toolkits; it does not offer consulting or advisory services.

## Toolkits
- [Toolkits and prices](https://sunilkumarfca.com/toolkits.html): Excel self-assessments for NGOs — institutional governance maturity ($149), FCRA compliance ($300), FCRA governance ($500), DPDP data protection ($100), compliance bundle ($700). Includes a 35-question FAQ.
- [FCRA compliance checklist and assessment toolkits](https://sunilkumarfca.com/fcra-compliance-toolkit.html): FCRA Compliance ($300) and FCRA Governance Professional Edition ($500, 6 pillars, 40 questions, 411 criteria) for Indian NGOs.
- [FCRA governance assessment toolkit for NGO Boards](https://sunilkumarfca.com/fcra-governance-assessment-toolkit.html): FCRA Governance Professional Edition ($500): tests whether the Board and management govern foreign contribution; 6 pillars, 40 questions, 411 criteria; sample Board & CEO report for a fictional NGO.
- [NGO governance assessment tool](https://sunilkumarfca.com/ngo-governance-assessment-tool.html): Institutional Governance Maturity Toolkit ($149): 60 questions, 8 pillars, 646 criteria, L1–L5 maturity scale.
- [DPDP Act compliance for NGOs](https://sunilkumarfca.com/dpdp-compliance-ngos.html): DPDP Compliance Assessment Toolkit ($100).
- [Free FCRA Compliance Essentials check](https://sunilkumarfca.com/fcra-compliance-essentials.html): free 50-point FCRA self-check for NGOs under the 2026 Rules, in the browser, with a score, critical gaps and an action plan; free until 31 March 2027.
- [Free Governance and Risk Quick Assessment](https://sunilkumarfca.com/governance-quick-assessment.html): free 16-question, 8-pillar governance and risk self-assessment for NGOs, nonprofits and foundations in any country, in the browser, with a score and five priority areas.
- [FC-4 Annual Return Readiness Pack](https://sunilfca.gumroad.com/l/fc4-readiness-pack) ($29): gather and check the new FC-4 disclosures for 2025-26 before the 31 December 2026 deadline.
- [Donor Concentration and Reserves Early Warning Sheet](https://sunilfca.gumroad.com/l/donor-early-warning) ($29): see donor dependence and reserve cover early.
- [Where to start](https://sunilkumarfca.com/where-to-start.html): match an NGO's problem to the right free guide, check or toolkit.

## Books (several free to read online)
- [The Strategic CFO — read free](https://sunilkumarfca.com/read-the-strategic-cfo.html): strategic finance leadership for mission-driven organisations.
- [The Resilient Institution — read free](https://sunilkumarfca.com/read-the-resilient-institution.html): NGO governance, board oversight and institutional resilience.
- [The Wealthy Life — read free](https://sunilkumarfca.com/read-the-wealthy-life.html): building financial, physical, mental, emotional, social and spiritual wealth.
- [All books](https://sunilkumarfca.com/library.html) and [complete bibliography](https://sunilkumarfca.com/publications.html).

## Knowledge Hub
- [Knowledge Hub](https://sunilkumarfca.com/notes.html): all topics.
- [Institutional Governance & Resilience](https://sunilkumarfca.com/ngo-governance.html): NGO governance, Board oversight, resilience and governance maturity.
- [FCRA Governance](https://sunilkumarfca.com/fcra-governance.html): FCRA compliance as an institutional governance responsibility.
- [The Strategic CFO](https://sunilkumarfca.com/strategic-finance-ngos.html): Strategic finance, the CFO role, budgeting and cash flow in NGOs.
- [Governance maturity: key concepts](https://sunilkumarfca.com/governance-maturity.html): the maturity scale, evidence-based criteria and the Governance Perception Gap™.
- [68 Questions CEOs Should Ask, With CFO Insights](https://sunilkumarfca.com/ceo-questions-cfo-insights.html): the essence of The Resilient Institution (2nd edition) as 68 CEO and Board questions, each paired with a Strategic CFO insight, grouped by chapter: board oversight, risk, CSR and ESG, blended finance, outcome financing, innovation, transparency, AI, cyber and data, leadership, institutional health and return on effort.
- [Where to Start: Match Your NGO's Problem to the Right Tool](https://sunilkumarfca.com/where-to-start.html): seven common problems (FCRA registration risk, Board oversight of FCRA, donor trust, compliance cost, DPDP data protection, institutional credibility, new CFOs) and four goals (earning and keeping donor trust, retaining and winning grants, becoming system-led rather than person-led, raising institutional value), each linked to a free guide, a free Quick Assessment where available, and the matching self-assessment toolkit or book.
- [Effective Procurement: Beyond Compliance to Governance, Culture and Programme Impact](https://sunilkumarfca.com/effective-procurement-governance-culture.html): why procurement failures persist despite sound policies; leadership by example, governance weaknesses, organisational culture, three-level root-cause diagnosis, five accountability measures, managing resistance, linking procurement to programme results, and indicators.
- [FCRA Administrative Expenses: Managing Within the 20% Limit](https://sunilkumarfca.com/fcra-administrative-expenses-20-percent-limit.html): Section 8(1)(b) 20% cap on administrative expenses; Rule 5 classification, one-year carry-forward from 1 January 2025, domestic funding of overheads, prior approval, monthly MIS; free PDF guide.
- [FC-4 Annual Return 2025–26: 10 Checks Before 31 December](https://sunilkumarfca.com/fc-4-annual-return-checklist.html): FC-4 due 31 December 2026; ten checks (FCRA account, 20% admin limit, activity report, ultimate donors, social media, key functionaries) and a timeline.
- [Is Your FCRA Problem Really a Compliance Problem? What Three Governance Assessments Showed](https://sunilkumarfca.com/fcra-compliance-or-governance.html): three FCRA governance assessments; compliance scored highest, risk, resilience and continuity lowest; questions and actions for boards.
- [FCRA Governance हिंदी में (The Strategic CFO, Chapter 10)](https://sunilkumarfca.com/fcra-governance-hindi.html): Hinglish audio and full Hindi text of Chapter 10: compliance-by-design, FCRA Amendment Rules 2026, ten common FCRA compliance failures with root causes and prevention, and seven Board questions.
- [The Strategic CFO, Hindi/Hinglish edition (Google Play Books)](https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=IWYfEgAAQBAJ): the complete book in Hindi/Hinglish, 291 pages.
- [The Strategic CFO, Hindi/Hinglish audiobook (Google Play)](https://play.google.com/store/audiobooks/details?id=AQAAAEBGhRzFSM): the complete book as a Hindi/Hinglish audiobook.
- [FCRA Amendment Rules 2026: What NGOs Need to Know](https://sunilkumarfca.com/fcra-amendment-rules-2026.html): purpose- and State-specific registration, FC-6F by 21 June 2027, key functionaries, ultimate donors, FC-4 changes.

- [Free videos and audiobooks](https://sunilkumarfca.com/watch.html): governance maturity webinars, FCRA governance series, Strategic CFO audiobook.

## About
- [About the author](https://sunilkumarfca.com/about.html): career summary, qualifications and areas of expertise.
- Contact: sunil@sunilkumarfca.com
- [FCRA Renewal Checklist: 10 Checks Before You Apply](https://sunilkumarfca.com/fcra-renewal-checklist.html): FCRA registration lasts five years and renewal must be applied for in the last six months. Ten checks NGOs should run first, including the new ₹10 lakh reasonable activity test.
- [What FCRA Non-Compliance Really Costs an NGO](https://sunilkumarfca.com/fcra-non-compliance-cost.html): FCRA non-compliance costs more than a compounding fee: frozen funds, suspension, cancellation, lost staff and donor trust. The cost ladder, where it starts, and the prevention budget.
- [Nonprofit Risk Register: A Practical Guide for Boards](https://sunilkumarfca.com/nonprofit-risk-register.html): How a nonprofit or NGO builds a risk register its Board actually uses: the 8 risk areas, how to score likelihood and impact, a worked example, and the mistakes that make registers useless.
- [NGO Donor Due-Diligence Checklist: What Funders Check](https://sunilkumarfca.com/ngo-donor-due-diligence-checklist.html): What foundations, CSR teams and international donors check before funding an NGO: a 10-area due-diligence checklist, the red flags, and how to keep a ready pack.
